slides.text:
Your child fights bedtime **every single night.**

Before you raise your voice, **change these 3 things.**

The problem is rarely the child.

It is usually the **transition**: fun one minute, lights out the next.

**1. Start winding down earlier.**

Dim the lights and slow the pace 30 minutes before bed. Screens go off first.

**2. Keep the same order every night.**

Bath, pajamas, book, lights out. Children relax when they know what comes next.

**3. Give one small choice.**

"Which book tonight?" Choice feels like control, and control lowers the fight.
